verdict.rationale: Viam has no documented natural-language interface of its own: no built-in assistant, chat, or prompt-driven control appears in the evidence. The 'use Viam from an agent' guide and the JSON-in/JSON-out CLI let an external AI agent drive a machine, but the natural-language layer comes from the user's own agent, so they count as building blocks or user-side workarounds rather than the product's own capability. A natural-language interface is a plausible feature for a robotics platform, so the axis applies and the verdict is none rather than na.
